subtitles.awaken.ascent.rappel_fit: A fitting snaps onto a rope
item.awaken.iron_line.what: A steel line for the Tether: the rope reaches 6 further.
item.awaken.gold_reel.what: A reel for the Tether: it winds the rope in half again as fast.
item.awaken.deepglass_line.what: Black glass drawn into steel, with the iron line's reach: lowering yourself, it pays out smooth and a little faster.
awaken.ascent.fit.no_rope: Nothing to fit it to yet. A vault keeps the line it belongs on.
awaken.ascent.fit.use: Use to fit it to your Tether. The one it replaces comes back to you.
